findings.evidence: template/scripts/agent_board.py `_declared_generated_paths` calls `generated_files(root, main_sha)`. In `_platform_common.generated_files` (lines 573-583), a missing `paths.checks` key or a file absent at the commit raises `TaskFreshnessError`, which is mapped to `_scope_gate_unavailable`. The candidate had to add `checks = "dev-platform/checks.toml"` plus a stub file to the fixtures in tests/test_git_lifecycle.py and tests/test_worktree_hygiene.py. That shows the new coupling reaches existing board setups. The design says to fail closed on an unreadable declaration. It does not say that a project with no check configuration at main is blocked, for example the first task that introduces `checks.toml`, or a project that has not yet adopted it. Confirm that the template guarantees `paths.checks` and that its file exists at main in every profile that enables `agent_board`.
findings.summary: Every admission or scope-gate recheck with at least one claim candidate now depends on the main-committed check configuration being present and valid. A multi-agent project whose `paths.checks` file is missing at `origin/<main>` gets a scope-gate-unavailable stop, even when it declares no generated files.
